description: §23.2.4a E-FOREIGN-007 — the inline slice is not valid JavaScript as written (`x +;`). The slice is evaluated as the body of a sealed async function, so an implementation must refuse it at compile time as an AUTHOR error at the slice — not ship an artifact that fails when the server loads, and not report it as a compiler defect.
rationale: §23.2.4a / §23.2.6 E-FOREIGN-007: an inline value-returning `_{}` whose slice is not valid JavaScript as the body of an async function SHALL be a compile error naming the slice. §23.2.3 opacity forbids type-checking or rewriting the interior; deciding whether the slice can be built at all is the same question the artifact's syntax gate asks of every emitted line.
